subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): re-export StatusSummary, SessionStatus, and HeartbeatStatus from command-status

question: Should plugins receive the complete transitive host `StatusSummary`, `SessionStatus`, and `HeartbeatStatus` shapes as supported public API, or a narrower self-contained status DTO?
rationale: The patch is additive and mechanically correct, but repository policy requires intentional promotion of internal types and the aliases create a compatibility promise across multiple internal owners.

options.title: Publish a narrow DTO
options.body: Define self-contained Plugin SDK response types containing only fields intended as durable external API.

options.title: Approve the full aliases
options.body: Accept the complete current host type graph as public API after installed-package consumer proof.

options.title: Defer to gateway ownership
options.body: Wait for the linked gateway invocation API to define and version its canonical response contract.

recommendation.title: Publish a narrow DTO
recommendation.body: Define self-contained Plugin SDK response types containing only fields intended as durable external API.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main provenance ties this person to both central files and the status implementation history.
